SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Conversational Skills: Polite Language, part of Strand 1 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade seven ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How would you introduce your parents or guardians to your teachers? 2. Why is it important to be polite while introducing yourself or others?
